title: Configurational Temperature in the 3D XY Model
summary: We investigate the configurational temperature estimator as a diagnostic tool for Monte Carlo and Langevin simulations of the three-dimensional XY model with an imaginary chemical potential. This estimator depends only on the field configurations. It provides a stringent internal consistency check for numerical sampling algorithms. We perform simulations using both real Langevin dynamics and the Metropolis Monte Carlo algorithm on an $8^3$ lattice across a range of coupling values, $β= 0.2 - 0.7$.
